newsitem.title: FRANCE: Prodi serious about lira ERM reentry-paper.
newsitem.headline: Prodi serious about lira ERM reentry-paper.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said Italy was serious about re-entering the European Monetary System's Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM), daily Le Figaro reported.
"After the approval of our budget law by Parliament, we will enter discussions with our partners," Prodi said in an interview.
"It is that dialogue which will allow us to decide the conditions under which a return can take place. For the moment we are giving evidence of our seriousness."
Prodi refused to specify what rate he thought would be an appropriate level for the lira when it comes back into the ERM.
"As for at what exchange rate that could happen, I will be careful. I will allow myself no forecast nor analysis. That goes back to the negotiations which must take place.
"I want to repeat to our European partners that the present re-evaluation of the lira is fabulous, incredible. It is the proof of the great confidence markets place in my government."
